  <link rel="stylesheet" href="../css/design-system.css">

  <link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="../Couriers/flaship-logo.png">
  <script>
    (function() {
      const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('theme') || 'dark';
      if (savedTheme === 'light') {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', 'light');
      } else {
        document.documentElement.removeAttribute('data-theme');
      }
    })();
  </script>

  <style>
    /* ===================================================
       HELP CENTER — Self-contained styles
       =================================================== */

    /* Ensure custom cursor only — no system cursor on hover */
    @media (min-width: 1025px) {
      .cat-card,
      .panel-article-item,
      .art-row-trigger,
      .faq-trigger,
      .popular-chip,
      .step-action,
      .nl-btn,
      .cat-panel-close,
      .sr-item,
      .art-cta {
        cursor: none !important;
      }
    }

    /* ── HERO ── */
    .help-hero {
      position: relative;
      padding: 180px 0 100px;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .help-hero-glow {
      position: absolute;
      top: -80px; left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 700px; height: 500px;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(50,109,164,0.18) 0%, transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .help-grid-bg {
      position: absolute; inset: 0;
      background-image:
        linear-gradient(rgba(50,109,164,0.055) 1px, transparent 1px),
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(50,109,164,0.055) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 48px 48px;
      mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 60% at 50% 0%, black 0%, transparent 100%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    /* ── HERO H1 ── */
    .help-hero-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(56px, 9vw, 120px);
      line-height: 0.92;
      letter-spacing: 0.01em;
      margin: 20px auto 28px;
    }
    .help-hero-title .line {
      display: block;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .help-hero-title .line-inner {
      display: block;
      transform: translateY(108%);
      will-change: transform;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--text-primary) 0%, var(--violet) 100%);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
    }
    .help-search-wrap, #popular-chips, #status-strip {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(20px);
    }

    /* ── SEARCH ── */
    .help-search-wrap {
      position: relative;
      max-width: 640px;
      margin: 0 auto 28px;
      z-index: 10;
    }
    .help-search-input {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 18px 56px 18px 52px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
      background: var(--bg-secondary);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      font-size: 16px;
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color var(--t-fast), box-shadow var(--t-fast);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
    }
    .help-search-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-dim); }
    .help-search-input:focus {
      border-color: var(--blue);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(50,109,164,0.15), var(--shadow-hover);
    }
    .help-search-icon {
      position: absolute;
      left: 18px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%);
      font-size: 18px; pointer-events: none;
    }
    .help-search-shortcut {
      position: absolute;
      right: 16px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%);
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 3px 7px;
      border-radius: 5px;
    }
    .help-search-results {
      position: absolute;
      top: calc(100% + 8px); left: 0; right: 0;
      background: var(--bg-secondary);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 12px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-hover);
      overflow: hidden;
      display: none;
      z-index: 100;
    }
    .help-search-results.open { display: block; }
    .sr-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 14px 18px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background var(--t-fast);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-card);
    }
    .sr-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .sr-item:hover, .sr-item.hl { background: rgba(50,109,164,0.09); }
    .sr-item-icon { font-size: 16px; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .sr-item-title { flex: 1; font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-primary); }
    .sr-item-title mark {
      background: rgba(52,154,226,0.25);
      color: var(--violet);
      border-radius: 2px;
      padding: 0 2px;
    }
    .sr-item-cat {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      color: var(--text-dim);
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 2px 6px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }
    .sr-empty { padding: 16px 18px; color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 14px; }

    /* Popular chips */
    .popular-chips-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 10px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .popular-chip-lbl { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-dim); }
    .popular-chip {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 20px;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: border-color var(--t-fast), color var(--t-fast), background var(--t-fast);
    }
    .popular-chip:hover {
      border-color: var(--blue);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      background: rgba(50,109,164,0.08);
    }

    /* Status strip */
    .status-strip {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      padding: 8px 16px;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 20px;
    }
    .status-dot {
      width: 8px; height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--success);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,201,141,0.25);
      animation: pulse-dot 2s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    @keyframes pulse-dot {
      0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,201,141,0.25); }
      50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgba(0,201,141,0.1); }
    }

    /* ── CATEGORIES GRID ── */
    .cat-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
    }
    @media (max-width: 960px) { .cat-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } }
    @media (max-width: 560px) { .cat-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

    .cat-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-card);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 28px 24px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: border-color var(--t-med), transform var(--t-med), box-shadow var(--t-med), background var(--t-med);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .cat-card::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: var(--gradient-brand);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity var(--t-med);
      z-index: 0;
    }
    .cat-card:hover::before { opacity: 0.04; }
    .cat-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--blue);
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-hover);
    }
    .cat-card.open {
      border-color: var(--blue);
      background: rgba(50,109,164,0.06);
    }
    .cat-card > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

    .cat-card-top {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .cat-icon {
      width: 44px; height: 44px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: var(--gradient-brand);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }
    .cat-icon svg {
      width: 20px; height: 20px;
      fill: none;
      stroke: #fff;
      stroke-width: 2;
      stroke-linecap: round;
      stroke-linejoin: round;
    }
    .cat-count {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      color: var(--text-dim);
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 3px 8px;
      border-radius: 12px;
    }
    .cat-title {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-size: 17px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .cat-desc {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.6;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .cat-link {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--blue);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      transition: gap var(--t-fast);
    }
    .cat-card:hover .cat-link { gap: 8px; }

    /* ── INLINE CATEGORY PANEL ── */
    .cat-panel-row {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
      overflow: hidden;
      max-height: 0;
      transition: max-height 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);
    }
    .cat-panel-row.open { max-height: 2000px; }
    .cat-panel-inner {
      background: var(--bg-secondary);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 32px 36px;
      margin-top: 0;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .cat-panel-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .cat-panel-title {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }
    .cat-panel-close {
      width: 32px; height: 32px;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      transition: background var(--t-fast), color var(--t-fast);
    }
    .cat-panel-close:hover { background: rgba(50,109,164,0.1); color: var(--text-primary); }

    /* Articles inside panel */
    .panel-articles-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
    .panel-article-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 14px 16px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background var(--t-fast), border-color var(--t-fast);
    }
    .panel-article-item:hover {
      background: rgba(50,109,164,0.07);
      border-color: rgba(50,109,164,0.15);
    }
    .panel-article-item.open {
      background: rgba(50,109,164,0.08);
      border-color: var(--blue);
    }
    .pan-art-num {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      width: 24px; flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .pan-art-text { flex: 1; font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-primary); font-weight: 500; }
    .pan-art-tag {
      font-size: 11px;
      padding: 2px 8px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: rgba(50,109,164,0.12);
      color: var(--blue);
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .pan-art-arr {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      transition: transform var(--t-fast), color var(--t-fast);
    }
    .panel-article-item.open .pan-art-arr { transform: rotate(90deg); color: var(--blue); }

    /* Article content expansion */
    .pan-art-content {
      max-height: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: max-height 0.38s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);
    }
    .pan-art-content.open { max-height: 6000px; }
    .pan-art-content-inner code,
    .art-row-content-inner code {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 12px;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      padding: 2px 6px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      color: var(--violet);
    }
    .pan-art-content-inner .api-pre,
    .art-row-content-inner .api-pre {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #121820 0%, #1a2330 100%);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 12px 14px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      margin: 8px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.65;
      color: #c8d4e8;
      white-space: pre-wrap;
      word-break: break-word;
    }
    .pan-art-content-inner {
      padding: 16px 16px 16px 52px;
      font-size: 14px;
      line-height: 1.75;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }
    .pan-art-content-inner h4 {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      margin: 18px 0 8px;
    }
    .pan-art-content-inner h4:first-child { margin-top: 0; }
    .pan-art-content-inner ol, .pan-art-content-inner ul {
      padding-left: 18px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .pan-art-content-inner li { color: var(--text-secondary); }
    .pan-art-content-inner .tip-box {
      background: rgba(50,109,164,0.08);
      border-left: 3px solid var(--blue);
      padding: 12px 16px;
      border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
      margin-top: 12px;
      font-size: 13px;
    }
    .pan-art-content-inner .tip-box strong { color: var(--text-primary); }
    .pan-art-content-inner .art-cta {
      margin-top: 16px;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      background: var(--gradient-brand);
      color: #fff;
      padding: 10px 20px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: opacity var(--t-fast), transform var(--t-fast);
    }
    .pan-art-content-inner .art-cta:hover { opacity: 0.88; transform: translateY(-1px); }

    /* ── ARTICLE ROWS (popular / new) ── */
    .articles-two-col {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 40px;
    }
    @media (max-width: 860px) { .articles-two-col { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

    .art-col-label {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 11px;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--blue);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      display: block;
    }
    .art-col-heading {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(24px, 3vw, 36px);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .art-row {
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-card);
    }
    .art-row-trigger {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 16px 12px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background var(--t-fast);
      border-radius: 8px;
    }
    .art-row-trigger:hover { background: rgba(50,109,164,0.05); }
    .art-row.open .art-row-trigger { background: rgba(50,109,164,0.07); }

    .art-row-num {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      width: 28px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .art-row-mid { flex: 1; }
    .art-row-title {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      line-height: 1.4;
      display: block;
    }
    .art-row-badge {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      padding: 2px 7px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }
    .art-row-badge.blue { background: rgba(50,109,164,0.15); color: var(--blue); }
    .art-row-badge.violet { background: rgba(52,154,226,0.15); color: var(--violet); }
    .art-row-badge.green { background: rgba(0,201,141,0.12); color: var(--success); }
    .art-row-time { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-dim); flex-shrink: 0; }
    .art-row-arr {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      transition: transform var(--t-fast), color var(--t-fast);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .art-row.open .art-row-arr { transform: rotate(90deg); color: var(--blue); }

    .art-row-content {
      max-height: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: max-height 0.38s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);
    }
    .art-row-content.open { max-height: 6000px; }
    .art-row-content-inner {
      padding: 12px 12px 20px 54px;
      font-size: 13.5px;
      line-height: 1.75;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }
    .art-row-content-inner h4 {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      margin: 14px 0 6px;
    }
    .art-row-content-inner h4:first-child { margin-top: 0; }
    .art-row-content-inner ol, .art-row-content-inner ul {
      padding-left: 16px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 5px;
    }
    .art-row-content-inner .tip-box {
      background: rgba(50,109,164,0.07);
      border-left: 3px solid var(--blue);
      padding: 10px 14px;
      border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
      margin-top: 10px;
      font-size: 12.5px;
    }
    .art-row-content-inner .tip-box strong { color: var(--text-primary); }
    .art-row-content-inner .art-cta {
      margin-top: 14px;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      background: var(--gradient-brand);
      color: #fff;
      padding: 9px 18px;
      border-radius: 7px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: opacity var(--t-fast), transform var(--t-fast);
    }
    .art-row-content-inner .art-cta:hover { opacity: 0.88; transform: translateY(-1px); }

    /* ── FAQ ACCORDION ── */
    .faq-two-col {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 16px;
      align-items: start;
    }
    @media (max-width: 860px) { .faq-two-col { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
    .faq-col { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }

    .faq-item {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-card);
      border-radius: 12px;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: border-color var(--t-fast), background var(--t-fast);
    }
    .faq-item.open {
      border-color: rgba(50,109,164,0.3);
      background: rgba(50,109,164,0.04);
    }
    .faq-trigger {
      width: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 20px 22px;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-align: left;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: color var(--t-fast);
    }
    .faq-item.open .faq-trigger { color: var(--violet); }
    .faq-icon {
      width: 28px; height: 28px;
      background: var(--bg-darkest);
      border-radius: 6px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 400;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      flex-shrink: 0;

function highlight(text, q) {
  const i = text.toLowerCase().indexOf(q.toLowerCase());
  if (i === -1) return text;
  return text.slice(0, i) + '<mark>' + text.slice(i, i + q.length) + '</mark>' + text.slice(i + q.length);
}

function doSearch(q) {
  if (!q) { searchResults.classList.remove('open'); return; }
  const matches = SEARCH_INDEX.filter(a =>
    a.title.toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase()) ||
    a.tag.toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase())
  ).slice(0, 6);

  if (!matches.length) {
    searchResults.innerHTML = `<div class="sr-empty">No results for "<strong>${q}</strong>". Try searching "COD", "label", or "Shopify".</div>`;
  } else {
    searchResults.innerHTML = matches.map((m, i) => `
      <div class="sr-item" data-slug="${m.slug}" data-idx="${m.idx}" data-i="${i}" role="option">
        <span class="sr-item-icon">${m.icon}</span>
        <span class="sr-item-title">${highlight(m.title, q)}</span>
        <span class="sr-item-cat">${m.tag}</span>
      </div>
    `).join('');
    searchResults.querySelectorAll('.sr-item').forEach(el => {
      el.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const slug = el.getAttribute('data-slug');
        const idx = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-idx'));
        searchResults.classList.remove('open');
        searchInput.value = '';
        // Scroll to category section and open panel
        document.getElementById('topics').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
        setTimeout(() => {
          openCategoryPanel(slug);
          setTimeout(() => {
            const panId = `panart-${slug}-${idx}`;
            if (document.getElementById(panId)) {
              togglePanelArt(panId);
              document.getElementById(panId)?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
            }
          }, 500);
        }, 600);
      });
    });
  }
  hlIdx = -1;
  searchResults.classList.add('open');
}

searchInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
  clearTimeout(searchTimeout);
  searchTimeout = setTimeout(() => doSearch(searchInput.value.trim()), 200);
});

searchInput.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  const items = searchResults.querySelectorAll('.sr-item');
  if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { e.preventDefault(); hlIdx = (hlIdx + 1) % items.length; items.forEach((el, i) => el.classList.toggle('hl', i === hlIdx)); }
  else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') { e.preventDefault(); hlIdx = (hlIdx - 1 + items.length) % items.length; items.forEach((el, i) => el.classList.toggle('hl', i === hlIdx)); }
  else if (e.key === 'Enter') { if (hlIdx >= 0) items[hlIdx]?.click(); }
  else if (e.key === 'Escape') { searchResults.classList.remove('open'); searchInput.blur(); }
});

document.addEventListener('click', e => {
  if (!e.target.closest('#help-search-wrap')) searchResults.classList.remove('open');
});

// Ctrl+K / Cmd+K
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key === 'k') { e.preventDefault(); searchInput.focus(); }
});

// Popular chips
document.querySelectorAll('.popular-chip').forEach(chip => {
  chip.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const q = chip.getAttribute('data-q');
    searchInput.value = q;
    searchInput.focus();
    doSearch(q);
  });
});

/* ── NEWSLETTER ── */
function handleSubscribe(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  const btn = document.getElementById('nl-btn');
  btn.textContent = '✓ Subscribed!';
  btn.classList.add('done');
  document.getElementById('nl-email').value = '';
  setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = 'Subscribe →'; btn.classList.remove('done'); }, 3000);
}

window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {

    if (typeof gsap !== 'undefined') {

        );

        // Step cards
        gsap.fromTo('.step-card',
          { opacity: 0, y: 36 },
          {
            opacity: 1, y: 0,
            duration: 0.6, stagger: 0.1, ease: 'power2.out',
            scrollTrigger: { trigger: '#how-it-works', start: 'top 85%', once: true }
          }
        );

        // Support cards
        gsap.fromTo('.supp-card',
          { opacity: 0, y: 32 },
          {
            opacity: 1, y: 0,
            duration: 0.6, stagger: 0.12, ease: 'power2.out',
            scrollTrigger: { trigger: '#contact-strip', start: 'top 85%', once: true }
          }
        );
      }
    }
  }, 400);
});
</script>
